description: cache refresh creates the missing state directory and writes one owned entry per bound result the reading caches: the instantiated imports of part.kdl and of its byte-identical copy copy.kdl share one invocation identity, so they are one entry with two derived lines (the second invocation replayed it), the second entrypoint is its own entry; each entry file is pinned byte for byte (versioned header, identity metadata, item lines), no part file remains, the entry lines go to stdout and the summary to stderr
